svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 01 · Santa Barbara · 09/12 Ten Thousand Bikes (Common)
svg.desc: Racks outside every lecture hall at ten to the hour. Remember where you locked it. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
